query:
SELECT pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object(
  'observed_at', pg_catalog.now(),
  'server_version_num', pg_catalog.current_setting('server_version_num'),
  'roles', (SELECT pg_catalog.jsonb_agg(pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object('name', rolname, 'superuser', rolsuper, 'bypass_rls', rolbypassrls) ORDER BY rolname) FROM pg_catalog.pg_roles WHERE rolname IN ('postgres','service_role','privacy_workflow_owner','anon','authenticated','supabase_storage_admin')),
  'ledger', (SELECT pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object('count', count(*), 'feature_count', count(*) FILTER (WHERE version IN ('20261013093518','20261013190000','20261013190100','20261013190200','20261016090000')), 'upstream_evidence_count', count(*) FILTER (WHERE version IN ('20261017043000','20261017140000','20261017160000'))) FROM supabase_migrations.schema_migrations),
  'helpers', (SELECT pg_catalog.jsonb_agg(pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object('schema', n.nspname, 'name', p.proname, 'owner', pg_catalog.pg_get_userbyid(p.proowner), 'security_definer', p.prosecdef, 'config', p.proconfig, 'acl', p.proacl::text, 'source_sha256', pg_catalog.encode(pg_catalog.sha256(pg_catalog.convert_to(p.prosrc,'UTF8')),'hex'), 'execute', (SELECT pg_catalog.jsonb_object_agg(r.rolname, pg_catalog.has_function_privilege(r.oid,p.oid,'EXECUTE')) FROM pg_catalog.pg_roles r WHERE r.rolname IN ('postgres','service_role','anon','authenticated','supabase_storage_admin'))) ORDER BY p.proname) FROM pg_catalog.pg_proc p JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace n ON n.oid=p.pronamespace WHERE n.nspname='review_media_private' AND p.proname IN ('reject_verification_object_update','guard_verification_object_delete') AND p.pronargs=0),
  'triggers', (SELECT pg_catalog.jsonb_agg(pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object('name', t.tgname, 'enabled', t.tgenabled, 'definition', pg_catalog.pg_get_triggerdef(t.oid,false)) ORDER BY t.tgname) FROM pg_catalog.pg_trigger t WHERE t.tgrelid=pg_catalog.to_regclass('storage.objects') AND t.tgname IN ('a01_review_verification_immutable_update','a01_review_verification_guard_delete'))
) AS metadata;
limitations: Read-only fixed catalog and ledger counts; no user rows or credentials read.
No DDL, operating apply, writer-fence change or runtime/provider readiness claim.
Feature five migration count is zero and expected helper/trigger objects are absent; effective helper EXECUTE matrix is unavailable.
